source.author: hor
source.text: si fractus illabatur orbis, inpavidum ferient ruinae.
source.text_original: si fractus illabatur orbis, / inpavidum ferient ruinae.
source.text_english: If the broken world should collapse, its ruins would strike him unafraid.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: perdidit ille simul omnes diuitias et succedentibus sibi malorum nuntiis ad singulas plagas feriebatur immobilis complens in se illud de sapiente praeconium: si fractus in illabatur orbis, inpauidum ferient ruinae.
reuse.text_original: perdidit ille simul omnes diuitias et succedentibus sibi malorum nuntiis ad singulas plagas feriebatur immobilis complens in se illud de sapiente praeconium: si fractus in illabatur orbis, inpauidum ferient ruinae.
reuse.text_english: He lost all his wealth at once, and as one messenger of disaster succeeded another, he was struck by each new blow while remaining unmoved, fulfilling in himself that praise of the wise man: if the shattered world were to crash down upon him, the ruins would strike him unafraid.
